prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Six fresh door-opening perspective drawings of this exact purple shell-decorated castle gate, for Aseprite. PORTRAIT transparent RGBA 1024 x 1536 sheet: TWO columns x THREE rows, six equal 512px square cells. In each cell draw a SMALL complete gateway, 350px tall at most, with wide empty transparent gutters at least 70px. Fixed front camera, gateway centered x=256 with threshold y=440. The purple pointed arch, masonry, side pillars, two small cyan windows, gold edging, crest shell, base plinth and lighting are the SAME and stationary in all six. Animate only the two red wooden door leaves, each attached to its OUTER vertical hinge, opening inward as a mirrored pair. Six row-major keys: closed; 10 degrees open; 25 degrees; 40 degrees; 60 degrees; 75 degrees fully open. Freshly DRAW the changing plank/panel foreshortening, visible door thickness, gold handles and the central gold shell ornament separating with its door halves. Keep the same left/right door ownership and exact hardware; no changing number of doors or floating ornaments. Do not rubber-warp or slide one flat door image, and do not deform or move the building. The visible aperture between open doors is TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA: no black fill, invented hall, light beam, character or room beyond. Crisp moderately detailed painted 2D toy storybook masonry and wood, clean defined edges. No blur, glow, cast shadows, matte, text, labels, numbers, grid borders or checkerboard pixels. Every complete gateway and open leaf fits fully inside its cell.
